#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

namespace IO {
	template<typename T>
	inline int Read(T &n) {
		T k=0, f=1; char c=getchar();
		while (c<'0' || c>'9') { if (c == '-') f=-1; c=getchar(); }
		while (c>='0' && c<='9') { k=(k<<3)+(k<<1)+(c-'0'); c=getchar(); }
		n = k*f; return 0;
	}
	template<typename T>
	inline void Write(T x) {
		if (x < 0) { putchar('-'); x=-x; }
		if (x > 9) Write(x/10);
		putchar(x%10+'0');
	}
	template<typename T, typename ...Y>
	inline int Read(T &x, Y&... y) { return Read(x) | Read(y...); }
}

#define LL long long
#define FOR(i, a, b) for(LL i=(a); i<=(b); i++)
#define ROF(i, a, b) for(LL i=(a); i>=(b); i--)

const LL Mod1 = 998244353, Mod2 = 1e9+7;
LL answer, n_value, Count1, total_sum[7];
vector<LL> values[7];

inline void generate_values(LL level, LL prefix) {
	if (level == 7) return;
	values[level].push_back((Count1 - prefix + Mod1) % Mod1);
	total_sum[level] += (Count1 - prefix + Mod1) % Mod1; 
	Count1++;
	FOR(digit, 0, 9) generate_values(level + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
}

inline bool is_valid(LL x) {
	const LL limit = 1e6;
	return x * limit + 999999 <= n_value && x * limit * 10 > n_value;
}

LL Count2, power_ten[7] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

inline void explore(LL level, LL number) {
	if (number > n_value) return;
	if (is_valid(number)) {
		FOR(i, 0, 6) {
			LL current = ((Count2 + 1 - (number * power_ten[i])) % Mod1 + Mod1) % Mod1;
			LL position = lower_bound(values[i].begin(), values[i].end(), Mod1 - current) - values[i].begin();
			(answer += total_sum[i] + current * values[i].size() - Mod1 * (values[i].size() - position)) %= Mod2;
		}
		Count2 += Count1;
	} else {
		Count2++; 
		(answer += ((Count2 - number) % Mod1 + Mod1) % Mod1) %= Mod2;
		FOR(i, 0, 9) explore(level + 1, number * 10 + i);
	}
}

int main() {
	IO::Read(n_value);
	generate_values(0, 0);
	for (int i=0; i<=6; ++i) sort(values[i].begin(), values[i].end());
	Count2 = -1;
	explore(0, 0);
	IO::Write(answer);
}
